oil_exposure.notes: Middle East ~15% of global PE capacity (S&P, Mar 2026); ~84% of Middle East PE capacity relies on Hormuz for waterborne exports; the region exported over 12.5 Mt of PE in 2025 (ICIS via IOM3). Middle East ~50% of China's 2025 PE imports (SunSirs). Hormuz share of naphtha imports in 2025: Korea ~50% of 630 kb/d, Japan ~70% of 400 kb/d, China ~40% of 410 kb/d (Kpler via Energy Intelligence). Japan FY2024: 74% of naphtha imports from the Middle East (JCER). 2026: China's Jan-May PE imports 4.55 Mt (-24% y/y), May 0.5089 Mt a ten-year low, while its exports rose 247% to 1.4392 Mt (SunSirs); Middle East naphtha exports 692 kt in Mar 2026 vs 4.06 Mt in Feb (S&P Commodities at Sea); Gulf naphtha to Asia 160 kb/d in March vs 1.4 mb/d in Jan-Feb (Kpler). All figures from search snippets.
